x: In the 100 yards championship, E. Gray once again proved the best of our short distance men, and retained his hold on the "Grosvenor Cup." Tom Wiley gained one of his many place medals.
We started will in the senior match and Ted Gray caused a surprise by beating the R.A.F. runner, B..

Ted Gray said he thought he would have a go in the Long Jump which took place in the pouring rain; and by doing 20ft. 2in. he tied for 4th place, and so gained what proved a most valuable half a point.

In the 100 yards Ted Gray, as last year, won his heat and so gained a place in the final. Wiard, of Blackheath, as expected, won the final and although close up, Ted was placed 4th, which was not so good as previously.
Belgrave entries for that meeting included E Gray (100 yds) T D Wiley (100 yds) reserves F W Pritchard and S C Botwright. 440 yds D G Michael, H E Pack, reserves T H Scrimshaw & A A Bird.
